description: Transcribe speech from an audio file at a public URL using Whisper large-v3-turbo. Returns the transcript text, detected language, duration and word count. Accepts common formats such as MP3, WAV, M4A and OGG up to 5 MB. Use for voice notes, podcast clips, meeting snippets and voice messages. Costs $0.02 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of an audio file (max 5 MB)

name: transcribe
